program.name: Gentle 35
program.subject: Gentle / low impact
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of gentle work: strength and balance, or easy cardio and a stretch.
program.about: Gentle training for about half an hour. One day is easy strength in straight sets with balance holds after; the other easy cardio on the minute with a stretch after. Nothing jumps. They alternate. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Gentle strength & balance / easy cardio & stretch, 35 minutes
